source.scope: Exact current records; immutable history omitted for focused regression only.

publications.title: Foster Draft Would Test Real-Time Reporting for Financial Regulators
publications.primaryFunctionalAudience: Credit-union regulatory reporting, compliance, finance and data leaders

candidateEvaluations.title: Foster releases regulatory reporting discussion draft
candidateEvaluations.rationale: Fresh congressional proposal explicitly addresses credit unions; not enacted or a current reporting requirement.

candidateEvaluations.title: Anthropic personal-finance beta
candidateEvaluations.rationale: Read-only U.S. beta; distinct consumer data-access story. Actual rollout and institution support require precise attribution.

candidateEvaluations.title: NCUA seeks additional argument in Jackson Area case
candidateEvaluations.rationale: Procedural request, not ruling; underlying memorandum and opposing motions not independently inspected.

candidateEvaluations.title: CFPB explains Navy Federal overdraft termination
candidateEvaluations.rationale: New trade coverage of an October report and earlier termination, not a fresh legal change.

candidateEvaluations.title: Redwood CEO describes tape backups
candidateEvaluations.rationale: Useful reported practice; timing and independent restore evidence not established.

candidateEvaluations.title: U.S. Bank Payment Switch
candidateEvaluations.rationale: New recap does not reset the October launch date.

candidateEvaluations.title: Addition Financial school affinity debit card
candidateEvaluations.rationale: Older local program extension with no observed adoption for the new market.

candidateEvaluations.title: Fed bank lending standards survey
candidateEvaluations.rationale: Bank respondents, not credit unions; no new policy or measurable CU outcome.

candidateEvaluations.title: DaLand Coin2Core certification
candidateEvaluations.rationale: Certification announcement does not establish CU deployment, member use or operational results.

candidateEvaluations.title: MEMBERS1st selects Mahalo
candidateEvaluations.rationale: Selection without a documented launch or observed benefits; similar digital-platform coverage is recent.

candidateEvaluations.title: OCC examiner AI guidance
candidateEvaluations.rationale: Already covered by the November 5 CUAI Alert.

candidateEvaluations.title: Texans CU workplace recognition
candidateEvaluations.rationale: Repeat award, not a new measurable workforce operating change.

validation.releaseGate: Exact-head isolated browser run and actual visual review required before merge; see issue #160.

before.nextCoverageGap: AI-assisted deceased-member servicing and beneficiary or estate-document evidence
